method: Live emulator navigation through captured, filtered inverter relay. Clock and configuration writes withheld. Native RTU write ACKs may be simulated solely to open conditional editors. Early read replies are from the inverter except separately logged synthetic generator-mode reads; later screens explicitly marked offline use a loopback-only mutable fixture without any upstream inverter connection. The existing alarm-page selector is the only forwarded limited write. Visibility, simulated ACK and physical write acceptance are distinct evidence.

ON: When the power grid is functioning normally, the battery discharges to the State of Charge (SOC) protection level, maintaining the battery capacity without further decline for use as a backup power supply during power outages.
